title: Estructura en Forma de Corazón a la Hora Dorada con Iluminación Trasera Dramática y Atmósfera Cinematográfica
prompt: Golden hour or sunset lighting, warm and intense light radiating from within and behind a heart-shaped structure. The shape's interior emanates brilliant orange and yellow light, creating dramatic backlighting effects. Strong rim lighting along the shape's edges. Light source creates powerful contrast between the structure's dark silhouette and bright interior. Sky shows warm gradients transitioning from deep red-orange at the horizon to deep purple-wine tones at the top. Rich saturated color palette dominated by warm tones: blazing orange, deep red, golden yellow, contrasted with cool blue-gray tones in the shadowed areas of the stone structure. Overall atmosphere is surreal, mysterious, and otherworldly. Color grading presents a cinematic dreamlike quality with high contrast and vivid saturation reminiscent of 1970-80s sci-fi album covers or film stills. Shape surface shows rough texture with visible weathering and erosion marks. Base of the structure is scattered with jagged irregular rocks and boulders, partially submerged in calm, reflective water. Water surface shows subtle ripples reflecting the warm light. Overall image has film grain texture suggesting analog photography or deliberate post-processing. Distant atmospheric haze or mist creates depth. Lighting reveals the three-dimensional form of the stone structure, with cooler blue tones captured on the right side while the left is immersed in warm reflected light. Cinematic composition, 16:9 or 2.35:1 aspect ratio, shot with wide-angle lens (24-35mm equivalent), low camera position, deep depth of field, high dynamic range to capture both bright interior and darker foreground details, film photography aesthetic with grain, professional warm-cool color grading.
